ModMetaData.name: RimworldMP

ModMetaData.description: From-scratch RimWorld 1.7 multiplayer (shared colony, LAN TCP, in-game host). v0.5.0: lockstep lobby + JIP, colony/DLC command surfaces, Compat API, ready/modlist checks, desync dumps. Requires Harmony 3. Build with RIMWORLD_DIR for full Verse patches.
